name: Sikkim Himalayan Adventure
summary: Six days that climb from Gangtok's cafe-lined promenade to 4,310 m at Nathula Pass — sacred Tsomgo Lake, butter-lamp mornings at Rumtek, Teesta river rafting and a sunrise date with Kanchenjunga. Real altitude, real permits, no technical skills needed.
highlights: Permit-day ascent to Tsomgo Lake and Nathula Pass (4,310 m)
Sunrise view of Kanchenjunga from Tashi Viewpoint
Rumtek Monastery and Gangtok's pedestrian MG Marg

itinerary.title: Into the hills
itinerary.description: Arrive Bagdogra/New Jalpaiguri, scenic drive up the Teesta valley to Gangtok (1,650 m), evening stroll on MG Marg.

itinerary.title: Gangtok & Rumtek
itinerary.description: Morning prayers at Rumtek Monastery, Gangtok Ropeway ride, acclimatization day with a momo food trail.

itinerary.title: Tsomgo & Nathula permit day
itinerary.description: Full-day protected-area drive: sacred Tsomgo Lake (3,753 m), Baba Mandir, and Nathula Pass at the India–China border — weather and permit permitting (closed Mon–Tue).

itinerary.title: Teesta rafting & sunrise viewpoint
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn run to Tashi Viewpoint for Kanchenjunga at first light, then rafting the Teesta's grade II–III rapids.

itinerary.title: Ravangla & Temi tea garden
itinerary.description: Day trip through South Sikkim — Temi, the state's only tea estate, and the giant Buddha at Ravangla.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Downhill drive to Bagdogra/NJP for onward travel.
